rule.name: GenericTypeName
rule.message: Name this type for what it does (PriceRounder, OrderTotals), not Utils, Helper, Manager, Common or Misc. Pure logic shared between features goes in the shared package under such a name. An exception fits only for a name a framework requires.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $words := 'Utils?|Utilit(?:y|ies)|Helpers?|Managers?|Commons?|Misc(?:ellaneous)?', $containers := '(?:Functions|Funcs|Methods|Modules?|Mixins?|Base|Classes|Impl)?', $generic := '^(?:.*[A-Za-z0-9])?(' || $words || ')' || $containers || '$', $roles := '(?:Authentication|Transaction|Cache|Entity|Session|Connection|Lock|Resource)Managers?' || $containers || '$' return //(ClassDeclaration | EnumDeclaration | RecordDeclaration | AnnotationTypeDeclaration) [let $name := replace(@SimpleName, '[0-9]+$', ''), $word := replace($name, $generic, '$1') return matches($name, $generic) and not(matches($name, $roles)) and not(some $super in (ExtendsList | ImplementsList)/ClassType satisfies replace(replace($super/@SimpleName, '[0-9]+$', ''), $generic, '$1') = $word)]
